This file lists the changes made by BigWorld to the python distribution.
This edition tracks the CPython 3.13.15 port (see docs/python-313-migration.md
for the full analysis and disposition of the 2.7.3-era patches).

All changes to source code should include BIGWORLD_BEGIN/BIGWORLD_END around
the changed areas of code.

Adding BWHooks for memory allocation
====================================
1. Include/bwhooks.h + Python/bwhooks.c kept from the 2.7 tree (plus a new
   BW_Py_calloc, required by PyMemAllocatorEx).
2. Makefile.pre.in: Python/bwhooks.o added to PYTHON_OBJS.
3. Unlike 2.7, malloc/realloc/free are NOT #define-redirection in
   obmalloc.c/pymem.h any more. The engine installs the official
   PyMem_SetAllocator(PYMEM_DOMAIN_RAW, ...) raw allocator (routed through
   BW_Py_malloc/realloc/free/calloc) and PyObject_SetArenaAllocator
   (BW_Py_malloc/BW_Py_free) from lib/pyscript/script.cpp before
   Py_Initialize(). This is the supported embedding interface in 3.x and
   keeps CPython core sources unpatched.

Making python compile and link statically with CMake
====================================================
Dropped. The 2.7-era CMake/libpython directory was BigWorld-specific and does
not exist in the 3.13 tree. Linux builds use ./configure + make
libpython3.13.a via build/make/third_party_python.mak. A Windows static
configuration would need to be regenerated for PCbuild if ever required.

Added VS2012 project files
==========================
Dropped. Obsolete toolchain; 3.13 ships its own PCbuild projects (VS2022+).

Fixed python linking shared modules to openSSL
==============================================
Superseded. The 2.7 setup.py hack has no direct equivalent: extension builds
in 3.x are driven by configure detection (Modules/Setup.bootstrap /
Modules/Setup.stdlib) instead of runtime probing in setup.py. The _ssl and
_hashlib modules link against the BigWorld OpenSSL build through the normal
configure --with-openssl= path when enabled; see third_party_python.mak.

Fixed build failures with pre3.5.0 versions of sqlite3
======================================================
Dropped. The patched sqlite3 code no longer exists in 3.x (and the vendored
sqlite in third_party/ is newer than the guarded versions).

Fixed line endings so windows mounts can build python (Parser/asdl_c.py)
========================================================================
Dropped. 3.13 tree normalises line endings; not reproducible/needed.

Added an official Python patch to address issue #17547 (-Wformat / gcc 4.8)
===========================================================================
Dropped. Fixed upstream long ago.

Making Python compilable on VS2015 (timemodule.c/posixmodule.c dummies)
=======================================================================
Dropped. Obsolete toolchain.

New in the 3.13 port
====================
1. Modules/_hashopenssl.c: hashlib_init_constructors() wraps the digest
   constructor table setup with BW_Py_memoryTrackingIgnoreBegin/End (the
   3.x replacement point for the 2.7 INIT_CONSTRUCTOR_CONSTANTS wrap).
